risks.risk: Engine model/code cannot be read, so exact compatibility and base value are unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp or manufacturer plate, usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker on the valve cover
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic used engine, lowest tier for its apparent size/type

risks.risk: Internal condition (knock, compression, wear) cannot be assessed from a static photo
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine running (cold start) with audible sound, plus a compression test reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. as a non-running/unknown-condition core engine

risks.risk: Mileage claim has no supporting evidence
risks.proof: Photo of odometer from the donor vehicle or an import/mileage certificate
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/high mileage, not low mileage

risks.risk: Completeness of the engine (missing sensors, turbo, injectors, etc.) cannot be judged from one angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, rear, both sides, and underside showing all accessories intact
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare/partial engine, missing accessory value excluded

risks.risk: 'Never opened' claim could hide a rebuilt or resealed engine
risks.proof: Close-up of head bolts, oil pan bolts, and gasket seams for tool marks or fresh sealant
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly opened/rebuilt, not factory-sealed

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/model stamp or ID plate
Video of the engine running, with audible sound (no knock check)
Photo of the odometer or donor vehicle mileage document
Additional angles: front, rear, both sides, underside, showing full engine assembly
Close-up of head/pan bolts and gasket seams to verify 'never opened' claim
response.reason: The single photo shows only part of a used engine with no readable code, plate, or model marking, and the price of an engine depends heavily on that identity; without it, even a worst-case price cannot be assigned.
